not_met.lacks: The generator can't see in the example what two of the template's slots become. First, the template's Tests section asks for a list of each component that makes a judgment no guard can hold, with that judgment, at architecture/template.md:174-177 and architecture/template.md:195-198. The example's Tests section at architecture/example.md:753-765 has no such list. Only one choice's cost, at architecture/example.md:786-788, names two judgments, and it names no component. So the generator has no instance of which parts to name or how to word a judgment. Second, the template's `<why>` asks each choice to name the key result of the product vision that it moves, at architecture/template.md:85-86, and Sequences, Deployment, Directory structure, and Tests take it as in Components. The example's choices in Components name one, such as at architecture/example.md:321-326. Its choice in S2: a point settled at architecture/example.md:456-460, its choices in Deployment at architecture/example.md:680-705, in Directory structure at architecture/example.md:745-751, and in Tests at architecture/example.md:767-811 name none. A generator that follows the example therefore can't tell whether a choice's why must name the key result it moves.
